title: AiUsageIndicator goes blank when the cloud AI usage endpoint becomes one pool: parseUsage requires meters.build + meters.dataChat, which cloud#2133 removes
body:
Filed by the cloud epic PM seat (`session_01FGca3Gt5irhBoVcVwFfoVY`, 2026-09-08T06:07Z) on behalf of the dev that implemented objectstack-ai/cloud#2133. Cross-repo consequence card: the producer moves in cloud, the consumer that breaks is here, and the dev could not file it itself because its dispatch was scoped to `repo:cloud` and it could not run the dedup sweep against this repo's issue list.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#2133

## What changes upstream

The 2026-09-08 pricing ruling (objectstack-ai/cloud#2131 item 1) merges the free and paid AI quotas into ONE pool. `GET /api/v1/ai/usage` stops answering a per-meter object and answers a single pool plus an observation-only split. Landing in objectstack-ai/cloud PR #2144 (draft at the time of filing, head `5cdab21`), on the tenant runtime.

- Before: the payload carried a per-meter shape keyed `build` and `dataChat`, each with its own cap and fraction.
- After: one pool reading, plus `breakdown` with the same two keys — but `breakdown` is each meter's share of the SAME single window, it is explicitly not a gate, and it can be absent when the split was not measured.

## What breaks here

Measured by the cloud dev against this repo's `main` (shallow clone, grepped, then removed), so treat the line numbers as a lead and re-derive:

- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAiUsage.ts` — `parseUsage()` requires `payload.meters.build` and `payload.meters.dataChat` and returns `null` when either is missing.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AiUsageIndicator.tsx` — renders two rings by iterating `['build','dataChat']`, and returns an empty render when usage is `null`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useAiUsage.test.ts` — asserts `usage.meters.build.fraction`.

Failure mode is SOFT: `parseUsage` returns null, the indicator disappears, nothing throws. So a paying customer simply stops seeing how much AI allowance is left, with no error anywhere to notice it by. That is worse than a crash for how long it can go unnoticed.

## What the fix is

Read the new shape and draw ONE ring for the pool. `breakdown` is the answer to "where did the allowance go", so it belongs in a tooltip or a detail view, never as a second gauge implying a second budget — the whole point of the ruling is that there is one number to explain. Treat a missing `breakdown` as normal, not as a parse failure.

Do not add a tolerant `??` fallback that accepts both the old and the new shape. Contract-first: the producer moves once, this consumer follows once. A dual-shape reader here would make the next wire change invisible, which is exactly how this one nearly shipped unnoticed.

## Ordering

Do not land before objectstack-ai/cloud#2133 does — the pin moves through `.objectui-sha` / the console overlay, and a consumer that reads the new shape against the old producer goes blank the same way in the other direction. The `Blocked-by:` line above is the machine-readable half.

## Dedup

Searched this repo before filing. The one adjacent card is #7371 (closed) — same component, different change: it taught the indicator the free tier's `resetKind: 'weekly'` after objectstack-ai/cloud#1843. Not a duplicate; that one was about the reset vocabulary, this one is about the payload shape. The zero-result query for the payload shape itself is a real reading, controlled by the #7371 hit on the same session.

## Note for the triage seat

Filed with `pm:queue` and no `domain:*` — the cross-seat transfer rule puts the card in this repo's queue, and the domain label belongs to this repo's triage seat, not to a cloud seat.
